title: Topology-driven token flow manager for multi-GPU serving
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and implement a topology-aware token flow manager that orchestrates token prefill and decode routing across tensor/pipeline stages to maximize communication overlap and improve p95 latency. The flow manager should be able to: (1) observe device topology (NVLink/PCIe/NIC hops), (2) predict inter-stage transfer windows, (3) steer token batches and micro-batches to create intentional comm/compute interleaving, and (4) provide hooks for the kernel selector and KV cache to prefer attention kernels and memory layouts that enable overlap.
background: Recent perf runs show that identical model shapes exhibit 10-25% p95 variance across node topologies depending on stage placement and microbatch phasing. Existing heuristics pin to a static token distribution which misses opportunities to overlap NCCL collectives with attention compute on heterogeneous racks. We need a runtime component that reasons about topology and token flow rather than treating scheduling as independent per-stage decisioning.
implementation_notes: Instrument per-stage compute and comm latency heatmaps (CUDA events + lightweight tracing)
Add topology discovery service: probe NVLink/PCIe connectivity and collect bandwidth/latency metrics at startup and periodically
Implement Flow Manager that exposes an API: submit(request_meta) -> placement_plan + timing_hints
Integrate placement_plan with existing kernel selector to favor kernels with smaller comm-critical sections during predicted comm windows
Provide fallback policy for constrained devices (single-GPU or poor interconnect): revert to low-latency decode path
Add simulation harness to test routing policies under synthetic topology profiles before running on infra
acceptance_criteria: Server-side: p95 decode latency reduced by >=15% on multi-GPU topologies with heterogeneous NVLink connectivity compared to baseline placement
Throughput does not regress more than 5% for steady-state saturated workloads
No correctness regressions in generation; deterministic outputs for seeded runs
Feature gated behind runtime flag and rolloutable via console with metrics and per-route toggles
Automated integration tests that validate comm/compute overlap behaviors on CI emulated topologies
tasks: 3) Flow Manager core logic and placement planner
4) Kernel selector integration and hints API
